title: Milk Chocolate Revel Bars
changes_from_base: An oat and almond cookie dough base and topping around a milk-chocolate condensed-milk fudge layer, replacing shortbread and caramel.
summary: Oat and almond bars with a milk chocolate and condensed-milk fudge layer.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Set the oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan) and line the large tin with a paper sling.

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Mix the oats, flour, sugar, almonds, bicarbonate of soda and 1 tsp salt. Whisk the melted butter, eggs and vanilla, then stir into the dry mix to a dough. Keep back about a quarter (roughly 330 g) and press the rest into the tin.

steps.title: Fudge
steps.text: Microwave the chocolate chips, condensed milk, remaining salt and 30 g butter on half power for 2-3 min, stirring often, until smooth and thick.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread the fudge over the base and crumble the reserved dough over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake about 30 min, until the topping is golden brown.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: Leave in the tin about 6 h until fully set, then cut into 24.

tips: Melt the fudge layer on half power to avoid scorching.
Give the bars the full setting time for clean squares.
Swap the almonds for pecans if you like.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
